instruction: Candid documentary full shot of an outdoor stone staircase surrounded by lush garden foliage in bright daylight. On the left, the man in the gray hoodie (R1) walks down the steps wearing a gray hoodie, blue shorts, and flip-flops, looking down with a smile. Beside him on the right, the barefoot bald man in the white shirt (R2) walks down in a white long-sleeve shirt and green cargo shorts, also smiling and looking down. The two men walk side-by-side down the steps in warm, dappled sunlight filtering through the trees, casting soft shadows.
elements: R1 is the flip-flop-wearing man walking down the stone steps while R2 is barefoot
R2 is the barefoot bald man walking beside R1 while R1 is the hooded man
R1 walks down the staircase on his own feet beside R2 rather than being carried or supported by R2
R1 and R2 descend the outdoor stone staircase side-by-side
stone staircase steps beneath both men as they walk down
lush garden foliage and bright daylight around the staircase
